title: Instagram Thud
blurb: Weighty, low and slightly percussive, Instagram's notification is one of the few alerts with actual bass in it. That thud-tap carries strange gravity for such a small event: something happened, someone reacted, the algorithm has news it considers urgent. A billion thumbs know it without thinking. Use it in edits about posting, going viral, or watching a like count move in real time — or simply play it aloud in a shared space and enjoy the synchronised phone check that follows. Social media's heartbeat, delivered one thud at a time.
